simple.meaning: to undulate (as the earth, the sky, etc.; also a field of grain), particularly through fear; specifically, to spring (as a locust)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to רָעַשׁ (H7493) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

definitions.full: H7493. raash [ רָעַשׁ ] verb quake, shake , intransitive (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew, so Aramaic (rare), and (once) רְשְַׁ toss, rage (of sea); Arabic , usually , , (loan-word?), tremble, quiver, quake ; compare perhaps Assyrian rêšu , exult ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular רָעֲשָׁה Jer 8:16 ; 49:21 , רָעָ֑שָׁה Judg 5:4 ; Psa 68:9 ; 3 plural רָעֲשׁוּ Joel 2:10 +, etc. Imperfect 3masculine singular יִרְעַשׁ Psa 72:16 , 3 feminine plural תִּרְעַשְׁנָה Ezek 26:10 , etc.; Participle plural רֹעֲשִׁים Jer 4:24 ; — quake, shake , of earth Judg 5:4 = Psa 68:9 , 2Sam 22:8 (|| רגז ) = Psa 18:8 (|| id. ), 77:19 (+ רגז ), also Isa 13:13 (with עַלכֵּֿן , + מִמְּקוֺמוֺ , pregnantly; || רָגַז ), Jer 51:29 ; with מִן causative 8:16 ; 10:10 ; 49:21 ; of אָ֑רֶץ מוֺסְדֵי Isa 24:18 ; of heavens Joel 2:10 ( לִפְנֵי causative; || רָגַז ); heavens and earth Joel 4:16; mountains Jer 4:24 ; Nahum 1:5 ( מִן person causative ), Psa 46:4 ( ב causative ); walls Ezek 26:10 ( מִן causative ); אִיִּים 26:15 (id.); מִגְרשׁוֺת 27:28 ( ל causative ); הַסִּמִּים Amos 9:1 ; all living things Ezek 38:20 ( מִמָּנַי causative ); of waving grain Psa 72:16 . Niph`al הָאָרֶץ נִרְעֲשָׁה Jer 50:46 is made to quake ( מִקּוֺל ). Hiph`il Perfect 2masculine singular הִרְעַשְׁתָּה Psa 60:4 ; 1 singular הַרְעַשְׁתִּי Ezek 31:16 ; ׳וְהִר consecutive Hag 2:7 ; Imperfect 2masculine singular suffix 3 masculine singular (הֲ)תַרְעִישֶׁנּוּ Job 39:20 ; Participle מַרְעִישׁ Isa 14:16 2 t.; — 1 cause to quake , subject ׳י , with accusative of heavens, earth, nations, etc., Hag 2:6-7 , 21 , compare Psa 60:4 ; nations + מִקּוֺל Ezek 31:16 ; subject man, with accusative of kingdoms Isa 14:16 (|| מַרְגִּיז ). 2 cause (horse) to spring, leap (like locust), man subject, Job 39:20 .
